Scale requires additional demand, working capital and delivery capacity.; automation levers: OTC & auction GIS screening; Redemption & assignment tracking; key risks: Nonredeeming liens; Title defects; Capital lockup; regulatory notes: Auction eligibility, interest limits and foreclosure procedures are local.; track ids: track_1; track_2; track labels: Asymmetric & Data-Arbitrage Plays; Grey-Zone Growth & Traffic Arbitrage; plays: id: hoa_super_lien_tax_deed_redemption_arbitrage; track id: track_1; name: HOA Super-Lien & Sub-Threshold Tax-Deed Statutory Redemption Arbitrage; mechanism: Price small HOA priority liens and tax-sale interests using jurisdiction-specific priority, notice, and redemption rules; returns depend on enforceable rights, not assumed title extinguishment.; inputs: County tax-sale and HOA lien records; Title report and statutory redemption calendar; Local counsel priority and notice opinion; workflow: 1. Screen small-balance liens against property value, senior debt, and sale eligibility; 2. Have local counsel verify priority, service, redemption rights, and purchaser restrictions; 3. Bid within a net-recovery ceiling and calendar every payment and notice deadline; 4. Reconcile redemption proceeds or pursue counsel-supervised title resolution after rights expire; metrics: Net realized recovery after legal costs; Capital days outstanding; Notice and redemption deadline compliance rate; platform risks: failure mode: Sale invalidation or surviving senior lien; trigger: Defective notice or incorrect assumption about statutory lien priority; impact: Loss of expected recovery and extended title litigation; detection metric: Unresolved title exceptions and notice defects per acquisition; fallback: Suspend bidding, seek available statutory refunds, and limit acquisitions to counsel-cleared interests; id: fractional_heir_share_partition_forcing; track id: track_1; name: Fractional Heir-Share Acquisition & Tenancy-in-Common Partition Buyout Forcing; mechanism: Acquire documented fractional heir interests at a discount reflecting illiquidity, then seek consensual buyouts or counsel-supervised partition subject to heirs-property protections and co-owner rights.; inputs: Probate files and verified heirship records; Title chain, occupancy facts, and independent appraisal; Applicable partition and heirs-property protection rules; workflow: 1. Establish ownership fractions, probate authority, and encumbrances before contacting sellers; 2. Provide transparent offers with independent-advice opportunity and modeled partition costs; 3. Seek voluntary co-owner buyouts or an agreed market sale before considering litigation; 4. If unresolved, use counsel-led statutory procedures honoring notice, appraisal, and buyout rights; metrics: Verified ownership share acquired; Consensual resolution rate; Net proceeds after carrying and legal costs; platform risks: failure mode: Heirs-property protections defeat assumed forced-sale economics; trigger: Mandatory co-owner buyout, partition-in-kind preference, or defective heirship; impact: Long holding period and lower realizable value; detection metric: Unresolved heirs and statutory buyout conditions per property; fallback: Renegotiate voluntary exits or retain the interest without threatening unavailable remedies; id: agency_ad_spend_card_multiplier_rebate_cycling; track id: track_2; name: Whitelisted Agency Ad-Spend Card-Multiplier Points & Volume-Rebate Cycling; mechanism: Route genuine client-authorized advertising spend through eligible agency payment arrangements to earn contract-permitted rewards and volume rebates, net of financing, processing, and client pass-through obligations.; inputs: Client media mandates and rebate ownership clauses; Issuer reward categories, caps, and repayment terms; Platform invoices and agency volume-rebate agreements; workflow: 1. Verify client authorization, platform payment permissions, and ownership of rewards and rebates; 2. Model eligible media purchases against reward caps, fees, liquidity, and rebate thresholds; 3. Pay only genuine approved advertising invoices without circular spend or fabricated transactions; 4. Reconcile settled rewards, client credits, refunds, and full card repayment each statement cycle; metrics: Net retained rewards and rebates per media dollar; Unfunded client exposure and repayment coverage; Invoice-to-reward reconciliation variance; platform risks: failure mode: Reward clawback or client-funded liquidity shortfall; trigger: Ineligible categories, prohibited payment aggregation, or delayed client reimbursement; impact: Lost rebates, interest costs, and card suspension; detection metric: Denied reward value and overdue client balances versus cash reserves; fallback: Move to client-direct billing or prefunded approved agency terms and stop rewards-dependent spending; id: tcpa_litigator_scrub_honeypot_arbitrage; track id: track_2; name: TCPA Serial-Plaintiff Docket Scraping & Real-Time Litigator-Scrub Firewall Tollbooth; mechanism: Offer consent-first outbound compliance screening using lawful docket-derived risk signals alongside mandatory do-not-call and revocation checks; plaintiff matching neither authorizes contact nor replaces TCPA compliance.; inputs: Permitted public docket data with identity confidence scores; Consent provenance, revocations, and suppression lists; Applicable calling rules and customer retention policies; workflow: 1. Ingest permitted docket records with source dates, minimization, and human identity review; 2. Check consent, do-not-call status, revocations, and calling restrictions before optional risk enrichment; 3. Suppress noncompliant contacts and route uncertain matches to review without planting honeypots or provoking claims; 4. Serve auditable screening decisions with correction, deletion, and retention controls; metrics: Contacts blocked for missing consent or suppression match; False-positive identity match rate; Screening latency and stale-record share; platform risks: failure mode: False identity match or false assurance of permission to call; trigger: Stale docket data or treating absence from a plaintiff list as consent; impact: Unlawful outreach, privacy complaints, and customer liability; detection metric: Consent-audit failure rate and upheld identity correction requests; fallback: Disable uncertain enrichment and require independently verified consent and authoritative suppression checks; platform risks: failure mode: Sale invalidation or surviving senior lien; trigger: Defective notice or incorrect assumption about statutory lien priority; impact: Loss of expected recovery and extended title litigation; detection metric: Unresolved title exceptions and notice defects per acquisition; fallback: Suspend bidding, seek available statutory refunds, and limit acquisitions to counsel-cleared interests; play id: hoa_super_lien_tax_deed_redemption_arbitrage;
